title: Forward Deployed Engineer
summary: Forward deployed engineers are software engineers who work inside a customer's team to make a company's AI or data platform solve that customer's real problem. They write production code, wire the platform into customer systems and data, and carry what they learn back to the product team.
dailyDuties: Meet customer teams to scope a problem worth solving
Write Python and SQL to bring customer data into the platform
Build LLM workflows and integrations for a customer use case
Debug deployments in the customer's cloud
Turn a proof of concept into a production rollout
Share customer feedback and reusable fixes with the product team

skills.expectation: Write production code and scripts inside customer environments

Deploy and debug on the customer's cloud
